clauses.gap: Open cells after web8a (fix round V19): 422 at the field for the term reasons (no field named by FE03 or BE03c; summary-level, ratified by DEC-244 4); 409 and unknown outcome of a NEW vocabulary (no id or key read exists; same-key replay is the reconciliation). The registry-digest 409 is closed (context re-read, values kept, changed selectors named); the locale 422 copy now says the language is not supported for this content type (DEC-230, DEC-244 4).

proposedLimitation: web8a closes, for the template create and successor designers (CMS-03C-01), the locale variant form (CMS-03C-04), the pattern designer (CMS-03C-12), the vocabulary designer (CMS-03C-16) and the term form (CMS-03C-03): 409 refetched by itself with the unsent values kept (template, pattern, vocabulary; locale chain mismatch keeps adopting its 409 body, DEC-242 item 2); the closed registry-digest 409 re-reads the designer context (template create, successor, pattern), keeps the values, replaces the block choices and names the selectors that changed; unknown outcome read back before any retry (template create and successor, locale; the pattern, vocabulary-edit and term islands already did), the locale retry being the identical request under its key and If-Match whatever the read saw (DEC-244 3); success refetch (vocabulary versions table; locale source, never adopting an older entry version; the term list already refetched). NOT closed: 422 reasons at a field for the term form (no field named; summary-level, DEC-244 4); a NEW vocabulary's 409 and unknown outcome (no id or key read; same-key replay); template and pattern success refetch is N/A (DEC-244 4). Cite a state part only when every island of that part, including web8b's, is closed.
